reviews.name: Jobijoba
reviews.note: Homepage heading lists Jobijoba under Les sites du groupe Telegramme, but the Hellowork group page and the Jobijoba footer name Advenn and Hellowork Group as corporate parents, so the parent is recorded with that conflict. The affiliation page sentence about Flux, API and Widget describes offers Jobijoba sends to partner sites, not how jobs get in, so ingest_methods is not-found. magnet.work returned HTTP 503 twice and was not read.
